//exclude: src/lib/__tests__ holds assertion harnesses ported from plain JS. They are run by Vitest (esbuild strips types) and DO fail the build on a bad assertion — see `npm test` — but they are not written to strict TS and are not part of the shipped bundle, so they are kept out of `npm run typecheck`, which exists to gate app code.
//exclude2: supabase/functions runs on Deno with jsr:/npm: specifiers, not on Next's Node/bundler resolution. Typechecking it here would fail on `Deno` and every remote import; it is deployed and checked by the Supabase CLI instead.
